nodes.label: Course Finder discovery layer (research stage)
nodes.rationale: Deliberately flat files only -- no Supabase tables, no app routes, no frontend -- until a build decision is made, so the research track cannot leak into infrastructure before anyone has agreed to it.

nodes.label: trust_tier model (body_confirmed / excluded / unverified / organiser_attested)
nodes.rationale: body_confirmed means the row came straight from the body's own official list; excluded means it was in-source but is not a real listing (e.g. cancelled). Provenance is recorded per row rather than assumed uniform across a source.

nodes.label: Course-finder CSV schema (raw-text fields)
nodes.rationale: date_raw and points_or_category_raw are kept as scraped text, not normalized, because every source formats them differently (HKIE time ranges, AHP Council '12 CPD credit points'). Normalization -- units, date parsing, multi-day handling -- is a real design decision that has not been made, so pre-empting it in the sample would bake in a guess.

nodes.label: hkie-sample.csv (HKIE CPD Calendar)
nodes.rationale: Pagination is AJAX-driven (ucfrontajaxaction=getfiltersdata), so only page 1 was pulled in this pass; ~4 more pages exist and per-row GPM/H&S/OTM category was not cross-referenced.

nodes.label: ahp-council-ot-2023-24-sample.csv (AHP Council OT Board)
nodes.rationale: 14 rows, one marked excluded because it was cancelled in-source. Two entries have Chinese-language titles summarised rather than transcribed verbatim, flagged per-row in notes so the deviation is visible.

nodes.label: Grounding the sample against the real accrediting-bodies seed
nodes.rationale: Cross-checked against supabase/migrations/20260709240000_seed_accrediting_bodies.sql BEFORE any of the research was written: PT_BOARD matches the PT manual exactly, OT_BOARD is absent so these rows describe a body the registry does not know about, and HKAM is an inert parent shell with none of its 15 Colleges as rows. Neither gap fixed -- flagged only, per 'keep apart from infrastructure'.

nodes.label: No identified source for medical (the GTM beachhead)
nodes.rationale: Engineering and allied-health sources are scrapeable, but the actual go-to-market beachhead has no equivalent source identified yet -- named openly as the 'honest gap' rather than papered over with the sources that happened to be easy.
